posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
the palette is limited to 256 colors, and nothing can change that - the program and format simply can't handle more different colors.
so if the original BMP has more than 256 colors, then you WILL loose colors and color information and quality.
the difference is how the program determines which colors to remove - a good program analyses the colors before combining similar colors to reduce the palette. And MS Paint is one of the worst image programs I've ever seen, even the Win10 version did not support transparency in png for example.

posts.author: Cherry
posts.body: The issue is that, if I remember correctly, Paint uses a fixed palette it forces the image into, that's why it looks horrible. It's just the wrong tool for the job, it's not a Pixelart program. For conversión IrfanView is very good, or you use a Pixelart tool from the start, like Graphics Gale or Aseprite.
